I lost it and got up and told him that he clearly looked uninterested. Then he asked me to sit and tell him what's the problem. I told him that he needed to guide me as to what are my next steps. But clearly he was in a hurry to leave. Please Avoid this doctor – very unprofessional and not interested at all. Very disappointed that Bethany hospital being such a reputed hospital has doctors like him too. Have never experienced anyone like him.
